instruction: Power down the equipment and allow the enclosure to cool
safety_note: Do not open the enclosure while hot

instruction: Inspect the ventilation path for blockage
safety_note: Keep hands clear of moving fan blades

instruction: Verify the cooling fan operates after safe restart
safety_note: Restart only after the equipment reaches a safe temperature

instruction: Measure the DC supply before restarting
Verify the supply is within the equipment operating range
safety_note: Do not probe exposed conductors on an energized circuit

instruction: Restart only after the overvoltage condition is corrected
safety_note: Follow the site's electrical isolation procedure

instruction: Power down the test setup before inspecting CAN wiring
safety_note: Follow the site's electrical isolation procedure

instruction: Inspect CAN H and CAN L connections and termination
safety_note: Do not work on live wiring

instruction: Restore the connection and run a communication check
safety_note: Keep cables secured away from moving equipment
Use the site's approved coolant handling procedure

instruction: Inspect the cooling loop for visible leakage
safety_note: Stop the test if leakage is present

instruction: Check valve V2 position and restore coolant flow if appropriate
safety_note: Do not open pressurized coolant connections

instruction: Stop the test and isolate the equipment
safety_note: Follow the site's equipment isolation procedure
Do not connect or disconnect signal wiring on energized equipment

instruction: Inspect the encoder cable for visible damage
safety_note: Replace damaged wiring only under the site's approved procedure
